title: Cross-DKG Federation Link
description: Authority-neutral, content-addressed provenance reference between records owned by independent DKGs.
x-non-equivalences: a cross-DKG link is not a truth claim
a cross-DKG link is not evidence qualification
a cross-DKG link is not consensus
a cross-DKG link does not transfer authority between DKGs
a cross-DKG link does not authenticate identities or institutions
a link digest is not a digital signature
x-source-of-truth: the source DKG's immutable canonical record
the target DKG's immutable canonical record
the graph/projection digests named by this envelope

x-interoperability.supported_graphs: any DKG with stable graph and record digests
x-interoperability.semantic_promotion: must occur through an explicit domain adapter; graph linkage alone never promotes a foreign record into evidence
